rules.interaction: Notice-only rule; does not restrict causes for eviction.

exempt_if.unavailable: residence in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility, or a non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility

rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords and foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy in Boston
rules.exemptions: Residences in a hospital, skilled nursing or health facility; non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility
rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A Boston landlord or foreclosing owner ending a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the notice to quit, and send a copy to the city. It cannot be waived and violation does not halt the eviction.
rules.key_value: notice of rights with notice to quit; fine $300 per day after warning
rules.quoted_span: The HSNA becomes effective on November 6, 2020.

notes: Ordinance passed October 2020, effective 2020-11-06 per this FAQ. Notice requirement only, no just-cause list; low-confidence fit for the category.
